footer.description: Crafting digital experiences that stand out. Elevate your brand with our innovative solutions.

1.title: 1. Information We Collect
1.content: We collect personal information you voluntarily provide via our contact form (name, email, company, message). Additionally, we automatically collect certain information about your device and browsing behavior through Google Analytics, provided you have given cookie consent.

2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
2.content: We use your contact information to respond to inquiries and provide customer support. Analytics data is used in an aggregated manner to measure website performance, understand user behavior, and improve our digital services. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

3.title: 3. Cookies & Google Analytics
3.content: We use cookies and Google Analytics to measure website traffic. Google Analytics may collect your IP address, device type, and browsing patterns. By default, no tracking cookies are set unless you explicitly click "Accept" on our cookie banner. You can decline or revoke this consent at any time.

4.title: 4. Data Security
4.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. However, please remember that no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

5.title: 5. Your Privacy Rights
5.content: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, or erase your personal data. You may also restrict or object to our processing of your data. To exercise these rights, please contact us via email.

6.title: 6. Updates to This Policy
6.content: We may update this privacy notice periodically. The updated version will be effective as soon as it is published on our website.

cookieConsent.title: We use cookies
cookieConsent.message: We use cookies and similar technologies to help personalise content, measure ads performance, and provide a better experience. By clicking "Accept", you consent to the use of cookies.
